title: العقرب الذهبي يهاجم بسبوسة والصندوق يتفتح! 🦂🗝️
opening_line: العقرب الذهبي يهاجم بسبوسة بقوة في النفق

scenes.narration: العقرب الذهبي يهاجم بسبوسة بقوة في النفق!
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot of an old dusty underground tunnel with stone walls. A massive golden scorpion with glowing claws lunges forward at Basbusa, a small orange cat wearing a blue scarf. In the same frame stands a very tall slim charcoal-black one-eyed cat spirit with one glowing green eye, twice the height of Basbusa, wearing a long white Egyptian galabiya, no scarf.

scenes.narration: بسبوسة فتحت الصندوق القديم بسرعة وطلبت المساعدة من زيكو.
scenes.image_prompt: Inside the same dusty underground tunnel, Basbusa the small orange cat with the blue scarf holds an open glowing wooden box. Next to her, a very tall slim charcoal-black one-eyed cat spirit with one glowing green eye, twice the height of Basbusa, wearing a long white Egyptian galabiya, no scarf, raises a paw to block the massive golden scorpion.

scenes.narration: الشرار طلع من عيون زيكو ووقف قدام العقرب المرعب.
scenes.image_prompt: A medium shot in the underground tunnel where a very tall slim charcoal-black one-eyed cat spirit with one glowing green eye, twice the height of Basbusa, wearing a long white Egyptian galabiya, no scarf, shoots bright green sparks from his single eye toward the massive golden scorpion, while Basbusa the small orange cat with the blue scarf watches closely.

scenes.narration: فجأة الصندوق طلع نور أزرق قوي عمى عيون العقرب!
scenes.image_prompt: A dramatic close shot inside the underground tunnel as a blinding blue light blasts out of the open box held by Basbusa the small orange cat with the blue scarf, illuminating the massive golden scorpion which stumbles back in confusion next to the very tall slim charcoal-black one-eyed cat spirit with one glowing green eye, twice the height of Basbusa, wearing a long white Egyptian galabiya, no scarf.

scenes.narration: العقرب هرب بس صوت غريب بدا يطلع من جوه الصندوق، يا ترى جواه إيه تاني؟ انتظروا الجزء الخامس!
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot of the old dusty underground tunnel, identical in framing and lighting to the first scene. Basbusa the small orange cat with the blue scarf stands frozen, looking at the open box. In the same frame stands a very tall slim charcoal-black one-eyed cat spirit with one glowing green eye, twice the height of Basbusa, wearing a long white Egyptian galabiya, no scarf, while a mysterious dark shadow looms on the tunnel wall behind them.

cliffhanger: صوت غريب بدا يطلع من جوه الصندوق وظهر ظل مرعب على الحيطة!
